description: Express.js route definitions for development/testing endpoints related to MongoDB database status, seeding data, and seed data verification, including models for sessions, deployments, users, and LLM costs.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/db-status
methods.description: Returns MongoDB connection status including host, database name, and connection state.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed
methods.description: Seeds database collections with sample data if they are empty, including users, samples, tenants, projects, sessions, and deployments.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/verify
methods.description: Verifies data availability by returning counts and sample documents from all collections.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed-llm-costs
methods.description: Seeds 90 days of LLM cost entries for at least 3 models if the collection is empty.
